user.title: Connect to ICA
user.description: Sign in with the personal identity number and password you use at ica.se.

data_description.save_password: Lets Home Assistant sign in again by itself when your ICA session ends. Without it you will be asked for the password each time that happens.
data_description.username: Twelve digits, YYYYMMDDNNNN. A hyphen or spaces are fine — they are removed.

lists.title: Choose lists
lists.description: Each list you pick becomes its own to-do list in Home Assistant. You can change this later.

reauth_confirm.title: Sign in to ICA again
reauth_confirm.description: Your ICA session for {username} has ended.

data_description.save_password: Save it this time and Home Assistant will renew the session by itself instead of asking again.

error.invalid_auth: ICA did not accept that personal identity number and password.
error.unexpected_response: ICA answered something unexpected — its sign-in page may have changed. Check the log for what was seen.

abort.already_configured: That ICA account is already set up.

init.title: Choose lists
init.description: Lists created in ICA since setup appear here. Unticking one removes its to-do list from Home Assistant but leaves the list untouched at ICA.
